newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher but trade routine.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar nudges higher but trade routine.

text.p: White sugar futures crept higher in routine trading on Tuesday with the widening August/October spread about the only feature of interest.
Traders said the London market was taking some of its firmer sentiment from New York, where attention was concentrated on the forthcoming May expiry.
Light commission house buying of the August/October white sugar spread was the main feature in London as the nearby differential widened out to just over $6.00 after $4.50 at the end of last week
"That's fairly steady at the moment...but it's all fairly routine stuff," said one trader.
At 1600 GMT August was up $1.30 at anintraday high of $311.50 and October up 40 cents at $305.10. Volume reached a modest 1,174 lots.
In physical news, most traders were pondering the likely tonnage and origins of deliveries against May raws and the recent Russian purchases.
Russia is thought to have bought a substantial amount of Cuban raw sugar over the past few days, mainly through the Black Sea port of Novorossisk but also through Riga.
Trading was quiet in Paris where just 301 lots were on the board.
August was up 10 cents at $310.90 and October down 30 cents at $305.00.
